propositions: A mixed-provider fallback chain's prompt caching capability collapses to 'none' because provider-specific cache keys do not intersect across candidates.
An operator observing zero cache read and zero cache write tokens on a chain-backed operation cannot distinguish this from a regression without documentation explaining the intersection behavior.

The accounting section of docs/llm-framework.md did not document that fallback chains disable prompt caching, creating an operator-facing gap between expected behavior (caching on single model) and observed behavior (no caching on chain).

runner_support._intersect_capabilities and rebar.toml already encode the conservative intersection logic and its rationale; the documentation section must reference these as authority rather than restating implementation details.
